name: Chloroxymorphamine
summary: Chloroxymorphamine is an opioid and a derivative of oxymorphone which binds irreversibly as an agonist to the μ-opioid receptor.

pharmacology.text: Chloroxymorphamine is an opioid and a derivative of oxymorphone which binds irreversibly as an agonist to the μ-opioid receptor.

uses.en: It is a laboratory research tool used to study opioid receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究鴉片類受體的實驗室工具，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究鸦片类受体的实验室工具，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Like beta-chlornaltrexamine, it carries a nitrogen mustard group that bonds permanently to the mu opioid receptor, but instead of blocking the receptor it switches it on.
fact.zh: 和 β-氯納曲胺一樣，它帶有會與 μ 鴉片類受體永久結合的氮芥基團，但它不是阻斷受體，而是啟動受體。
fact.zhHans: 和 β-氯纳曲胺一样，它带有会与 μ 鸦片类受体永久结合的氮芥基团，但它不是阻断受体，而是启动受体。
